name: B10-0061/2026 – Motion for a resolution
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION seeking an opinion from the Court of Justice on the compatibility with the Treaties of the proposed Partnership Agreement between the European Union and its Member States, of the one part, and the Common Market of the South, the Argentine Republic, the Federative Republic of Brazil, the Republic of Paraguay and the Oriental Republic of Uruguay, of the other part, and the proposed Interim Agreement on Trade between the European Union, of the one part, and the Common Market of the South, the Argentine Republic, the Federative Republic of Brazil, the Republic of Paraguay and the Oriental Republic of Uruguay, of the other part
part_text:
1. This report asks the European Union's highest court to check whether two planned trade deals with South American countries are allowed under EU law. It questions whether the European Commission was right to split one negotiated deal into two separate ones, and whether the deals protect the environment, food safety and the European Parliament's right to be informed and approve. The Parliament is not deciding the deals itself here; it is asking the court for its opinion.

2. Bullet points:
- The Parliament asks the Court of Justice for a legal opinion on the two planned EU–Mercosur deals.
- It affects the Commission, EU governments, national parliaments and EU farmers and consumers.
- Next, the Parliament's President requests the opinion; the deals cannot be concluded until the court rules.
